Use this branch when a noisy grid has a distinctive single-color motif amid zeros and another background color, and the examples suggest copies are formed by translation.

1. Record the motif's colored-cell offsets from its bounding box. Search legal translations within the grid whose motif positions all contain zeros; recolor those matching positions with the motif color.

4. Check the result against every demonstration's changed and unchanged cells before applying the inferred rule to the current grid.
